% ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Styles and colors
% ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Requires \usepackage{tikz-3dplot}

% Required TikZ libraries for non-circular point shapes:
% \usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric,shapes.symbols}

% External TikZ styles referenced below.
% Load these files in your LaTeX preamble or before the picture:
% - tiny-cylinder.sty
% Suggested:
%   \input{tiny-cylinder.sty}

\definecolor{stzPointpFill}{HTML}{000000}
\definecolor{stzPointpStroke}{HTML}{000000}
\definecolor{stzPointpText}{HTML}{000000}
\pgfdeclarelayer{stratifiedLayer0}
\pgfsetlayers{stratifiedLayer0,main}

\tdplotsetmaincoords{13}{-23}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
    tdplot_main_coords,
    line cap=round,
    line join=round
]

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Coordinates
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    \coordinate (pointPoint0p0) at (0,0,0);

    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    % Layered drawing commands
    % ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    % Layer 0: stratifiedLayer0
    \begin{pgfonlayer}{stratifiedLayer0}
        %----------------------------------------
        % Codimension 3 strata: points
        %----------------------------------------
        \node[
            cylinder,
            shape border uses incircle=true,
            inner sep=1.5pt,
            inner xsep=5pt,
            inner ysep=0pt,
            outer xsep=0pt,
            outer ysep=0pt,
            minimum width=0pt,
            minimum height=80pt,
            tinyCylinder,
            fill=stzPointpFill,
            draw=stzPointpStroke,
            text=stzPointpText,
            fill opacity=1,
            draw opacity=1,
            text opacity=1,
            line width=0.4pt,
            solid,
            dash phase=0pt,
            line cap=butt,
            line join=miter
        ] at (pointPoint0p0) {};

    \end{pgfonlayer}

    % Codimension 1 strata: sheets
    % Codimension 2 strata: curves
    % Labels

\end{tikzpicture}
